text: 57 1. Read aloud. Minku, the monkey was playing under a tree. The tree was near a lake. Minku found some groundnuts lying near the tree. He was hungry. Minku cracked open the groundnuts and ate them all. Suddenly, he heard a loud sound of bees buzzing. “Help, help,” cried the bees. Minku saw the honey bees falling into the lake. He ran to see them. Their wings had become wet. They were unable to fly. Quickly, Minku threw the empty groundnut shells into the water. A gust of wind blew the empty shells towards the honey bees. The honey bees climbed onto the shells. Their wings soon dried. Minku, the Monkey 3.10
